title: when the cloud refuses an act, a session on the owner's computer does it first
why: Item 39 (Oct 28): the cloud proxy refuses branch deletes (403), so the step went to shiv as a Mac task; he had a session on his Windows PC do all of it (15 claude-settings deletes with the plan's lease command, 10 child branches archived first, then deleted). The item handed him work a session could do.
note: Slug cloud-refusal-goes-to-a-pc-session (orchestrator, Oct 28). Next cloud lane, claude-settings only. When the cloud proxy refuses an act (a branch delete, anything else), the session asks a session on the owner's computer to do it before it puts a task on the waiting page: Remote Control (list_computer_folders, then request_computer_folder) or a bridge session. A waiting-page task then names the check that showed no computer session could do it, which skills/waiting-page requires and the writer refuses without (red first on item 39's old shape). Touches the waiting-page skill and the practice of rule output-never-hand-off-doable-step. Same files as c190, so it follows c190. Port: yes, skills install everywhere. Needs no answer. Placed after c190 (triage 12, Oct 28).
